How to add scopes for payroll to a production app?

I haven't been able to send a successful GraphQL request to the QuickBooks Payroll API yet, after following the documentation. The root of my problem is that every request is met with a 403 error and an empty response body.

Since QuickBooks has no access token debugger or similar that would allow me to view the scopes for my token, I can only assume the 403 is because my token is valid but doesn't have permission. This is supported by the fact that using an incorrect access token gives me an actual error response about failed auth.

I attempted to add the scopes in my access token request (scopes = com.intuit.quickbooks.accounting, com.intuit.quickbooks.payment, qb.payroll.compensation.read) but that made no difference.

Checking the developer portal, I see nothing about payroll or payroll scopes. Modifying my existing production app, or creating a new one, only gives options for QuickBooks Online - com.quickbooks.online.accounting and com.quickbooks.online.payments.

When attempting to add the scope qb.payroll.compensation to my app URL, I get the error "invalid scope". It isn't present in the list of scopes accepted either, so I don't understand how this scope is supposed to be used.

What do I need to do in order to authenticate my app correctly with the Payroll API?

During the OAuth exchange:







{



// preexisting scopes



"com.intuit.quickbooks.accounting",



"address",



"email",



"openid",



"phone",



"profile",



// new scopes



"qb.employee.read",



"qb.payroll.compensation.read"



}







Works for our use case.
